# auth.md — Mauritius Yokoyama Issei Portfolio

This document describes how AI agents can authenticate (or consume without need of credentials) the public data of this portfolio.

## Protected resources

- Resource: `https://mauricio.issei.com.br`
- Authorization Server: `https://mauricio.issei.com.br` (metadata in `/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server` and `/.well-known/openid-configuration`)
- Protected Resource Metadata: `/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource`
- Available Scopes: `cv:read`, `projects:read`, `profile`
- Token presentation method: `header` (Bearer)

## Agent log

The above scopes expose only public reading data (curriculum, projects, profile). No registration of credentials is required for reading consumption:

```json
{
  "identity_types_supported": ["anonymous"],
  "anonymous": {
    "credential_types_supported": ["none"]
  },
  "claim_uri": "https://mauricio.issei.com.br/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource"
}
```

## agent auth

```json
{
  "agent_auth": {
    "skill": "portfolio-read",
    "register_uri": "https://mauricio.issei.com.br/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource",
    "methods": [
      {
        "type": "anonymous",
        "scopes": ["cv:read", "projects:read", "profile"]
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

For full details of the MCP server and available tools, see `/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json`.
